description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcel of Kondadeniya, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320330 and 17 other land parcels
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land parcel registrations across various districts (Kandy, Hambantota, Kalutara). This content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, ownership claims, and title settlement matters.
